issues.detail: All three tables supply restrictive mobileColumns (421,606,683) without mobilePresentation or row expansion. DataTable:504-505 only enables full mobile presentation when supplied, and 725 hides excluded cells below md. Mobile rate rows omit the Remove action, grid intensity and bounding box; apportionment omits distance, drives, energy, charges, registration and emissions; filings omit distance, energy and seal. This is source-confirmed hiding, not measured viewport acceptance.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing typed DataTable mobile presentation/details contract, preserving every field and Remove action; do not merely delete mobile allow-lists without checking narrow-width containment.

observations: Analysis Select has localized aria-label (366). Inputs have localized labels and native constraints. Decorative icons explicitly aria-hidden. Delete uses shared useConfirm/ConfirmDialog. Confidence includes numeric percentage rather than color alone.

issues.detail: Rate and filing toggle buttons (451,629) expose Add/Cancel labels but no aria-expanded or aria-controls relationship to their conditional inline forms.
issues.fix: Add stable caller-owned form container IDs and matching disclosure attributes to existing Buttons, retaining cancel/draft behavior.

unverified: Keyboard order and focus after opening/closing editors or confirmation

observations: All six panel shells remain mounted. OwnershipPanel:41-47 distinguishes disabled, editing, fatal, loading, stale retained and empty. SourceContent:39-72 provides skeleton/status, error recovery, empty body and retained-data retry.
PageLayout query array provides shared page-tier freshness, with report-specific stale label and last update in the brief. Rates/filings errors do not replace independent report panels.
Array nulls normalize to [] at page:104-106. Mutations have pending states and inline MutationError; toast handling remains in hooks.
No vehicle disables report/filing reads and seal submit; rates remain available. Disabled report panels fall back to generic empty copy rather than specific vehicle selection guidance.

issues.detail: Period liability sets empty={!report} without preserveSummary. OwnershipPanel:50-65 replaces children with skeleton/empty/error, so complianceSummary's six missing metrics, unknown period and unknown currency explanations are not shown on those states. Existing preserveSummary API already supports keeping the source-backed summary; this is not a claim that available data are fabricated.
issues.fix: Use the existing preserveSummary policy where appropriate and explicitly review no-vehicle/initial/fatal/empty states; preserve missing reasons without presenting stale or unknown data as current.

visualIssues.detail: Seal metadata and period digest (page:703) use fixed text-cyan-300 and ad-hoc text-xs/text-sm; jurisdiction icons also use cyan (130). Seven fixed accent-class occurrences include semantic liability/confidence coloring, which must not be indiscriminately removed. These are toned-down accents, not literal neon classes, but metadata colors bypass theme text roles.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Code/Text and neutral semantic text tokens for fingerprints/metadata; retain subdued warning/success/error meanings for liability/confidence with real contrast validation.

visualIssues.detail: Evidence cards use fixed border-white and bg-white opacity surfaces; cyan icon accents occur at 64/126. Domain-wide light/custom-theme suitability is not established by source.
visualIssues.fix: Owner of the reused evidence component should replace decorative fixed-white surfaces with existing neutral surface/border tokens; preserve source details, quality and unsupported/legal notices.

architectureIssues.detail: A locally-owned windowDays Select controls apportionment, while /ownership/jurisdiction-compliance is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope:23-77); no useRangeState is consumed. useComplianceApportionment:602-607 sends only window_days, not two instant bounds. This is a workspace integration gap, not a duplicate visible header date picker. Business filing dates are independently legitimate and must remain.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate the shared route-scope/hook/server extension to accept both workspace bounds with timezone/rolling/custom semantics before page adoption. Keep current 90-day default and 30/90/180/365 choices until a preservation-safe policy is agreed; do not client-filter the current response.

architectureIssues.detail: Filings fetch only limit=50 offset=0. The page passes items but never total, paginationControls, offset state or load-more. Later records are unreachable through this page, and default table exports cover loaded records rather than the entire server result.
architectureIssues.fix: Wire existing server pagination/total and explicitly labeled loaded/full-result export scope; do not invent an unsupported full-result endpoint.

architectureIssues.detail: Apportionment distance/roadUsage/liability and filing period declare sortable:true, but their DataTable calls provide neither onSort nor sortKey. DataTable:1557 renders a sort button only with onSort; no page sorting adapter exists.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing controlled sorting helper with canonical typed accessors (distance_m, road_usage_charge_minor, total_liability_minor, period_start), retaining source ordering and table persistence policies.

architectureIssues.detail: formatPricePerDistance defaults its separate locale argument to en-US, while page:254/257/510 pass only units.unitPrefs. Thus rate hints/cells do not use units.locale in this formatter even though monetary amount cells explicitly do.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass the saved locale explicitly at page call sites or coordinate a compatible formatter-owner fix using units.locale; keep minor-unit and per-metre semantics unchanged.

architectureIssues.detail: Business-period inputs require dates but have no coupled start/end constraint or field-level validation; rate bounding-box inputs constrain individual lat/lng but do not check min<=max. Server validation and interval inclusivity were not traced beyond the handler boundary.
architectureIssues.fix: Add localized coupled-field feedback using current form primitives without changing server semantics; explicitly verify period end semantics before any change to UTC instants.
